    Tests for ModuleSyntax #

    source
    def Experiment.TestModule :
    Type 1

    The module type declared by moduletype TestModule, with fields main, aux: the type Module TestModule.typeRep of modules that are a right-nested tuple of the field types.

    Build one from a record of its fields with TestModule.mk, read a single field off one with the accessors TestModule.main, TestModule.aux, and get the whole record back with TestModule.structure.

    Equations
    • Experiment.TestModule = GaudisCrypt.Module Experiment.TestModule.typeRep
    Instances For
      source
      @[reducible]
      noncomputable def Experiment.TestModule.mk :
      Structure → TestModule

      Builds a module of type TestModule from the record TestModule.Structure of its fields, as a right-nested Module.pair'. @[reducible].

      Inverse of TestModule.structure (TestModule.mk_destruct, TestModule.destruct_mk); a single field of a module built this way is read back by the @[simp] lemmas TestModule.main.mk_simp, TestModule.aux.mk_simp.

      Equations
      • Experiment.TestModule.mk theRecord✝ = GaudisCrypt.Module.pair' theRecord✝.main theRecord✝.aux

        TestModule → Structure

        The record of a module's fields: TestModule.structure m is TestModule.Structure.mk applied to TestModule.main, TestModule.aux of m.

            noncomputable def Experiment.TestModule.main.utilities :
            GaudisCrypt.ModuleTypeUtilities TestModule (procmod (String, ℕ) → Bool) main

            What is derivable about the accessor TestModule.main, bundled into one ModuleTypeUtilities (one name per field in the namespace, rather than one per fact):

            • TestModule.main.utilities.accessorModule : TestModule →ₘ … — the accessor as a module, a projection being a module morphism;
            • TestModule.main.utilities.apply_simp — Module.app TestModule.main.utilities.accessorModule m = TestModule.main m: applying that module is the accessor;
            • TestModule.main.utilities.expression_eq — the same at the level of expressions: (TestModule.main m).expression = (TestModule.main.utilities.proj m.expression).reduce.

                  instance Experiment.instIsModuleTestModule :
                  GaudisCrypt.IsModule TestModule

                  The IsModule TestModule instance: TestModule is a module type, with representation TestModule.typeRep.

                  It is what lets the name TestModule stand where a module type is expected — in Module.Arr/Module.Prod (→ₘ/×ₘ), say — which the underlying Module TestModule.typeRep would do on its own but TestModule, a plain (non-reducible) def, would not.

                                                                          theorem Experiment.X.h.procedure.apply_simp (holeArgs✝ : GaudisCrypt.HoleSigs.empty.Instantiation) :
                                                                          procedure.instantiate holeArgs✝ = proc () : Unit { skip; return () }

                                                                          Instantiating the holes of X.h.procedure with a tuple holeArgs of procedures: the body of proc h as written, with each hole call replaced by the matching holeArgs.lookup (HoleIndex.zero being the first hole the body declared).                                                                           Deliberately not @[simp], unlike the other apply_simp lemmas: its right-hand side is the whole body written out, so letting it fire on its own would turn any goal mentioning an instantiated procedure into that body.                                                                                                                                                                                               (procedure n).instantiate holeArgs✝ = proc () : Bool { var x : Fin (n + 1), b : Bool; x <- call (holeArgs✝.lookup GaudisCrypt.HoleIndex.zero) (); b <- call (holeArgs✝.lookup GaudisCrypt.HoleIndex.zero.succ) (§x); return §b }

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Experiment.Shadow.use.mk_simp (k : ℕ) (theRecord✝ : Structure k) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            use k (mk k theRecord✝) = theRecord✝.use

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            @[simp]: reading the field use back off a module built from a record — Shadow.use (Shadow.mk r) = r.use.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            It is what carries the right-hand side of an X.apply_simp (which is an Shadow.mk) on to the field the caller actually asked for, so that simp chains X.apply_simp into X.use.apply_simp.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              @[simp]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              theorem Experiment.WrapSized.use.apply_simp (n : ℕ) (S : Sized n) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              GaudisCrypt.Module.app (use n) S = GaudisCrypt.Module.proc ((procedure n).instantiate (Sized.use n S).procedure)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              @[simp]: applying WrapSized.use to the parameters proc use uses (S) is Module.proc (WrapSized.use.procedure.instantiate …) — the procedure with its holes filled by the callees they were made from, each written as it was in the body (with the arguments in place of the module parameters) and turned into a Procedure by Module.Proc.procedure.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              @[simp]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              theorem Experiment.WrapSized.apply_simp (n : ℕ) (S : Sized n) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              GaudisCrypt.Module.app (WrapSized n) S = Sized.mk n { gen := GaudisCrypt.Module.app (gen n) S, use := GaudisCrypt.Module.app (use n) S }

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              @[simp]: applying WrapSized to a tuple of its single parameter S — the record of its procedures WrapSized.gen, WrapSized.use, each applied to the parameters it uses.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              This is the lemma that unfolds a module use: simp rewrites with it, then with the field lemmas of the module type (N.f.mk_simp) to get at the one procedure the goal is about, and then with WrapSized.gen.apply_simp, WrapSized.use.apply_simp to fill that procedure's holes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              (procedure n).instantiate holeArgs✝ = proc () : (Fin (n + 1)) { var r : Fin (n + 1); r <- call (holeArgs✝.lookup GaudisCrypt.HoleIndex.zero) (); return §r }

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          noncomputable def Experiment.NamedProcs.p.procedure :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          proctype (ℕ, ℕ) -> ℕ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The body of proc p of module NamedProcs, as a procedure of its own: it calls no module parameter, so it has no holes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A hole stands for a call whose callee is not known here — a module parameter is supplied only when the module is applied — so the body is a ProcedureWithHoles, to be instantiated (see NamedProcs.p.procedure.apply_simp) rather than run. Use NamedProcs.p for this procedure as a module.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Equations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Experiment.NamedProcs.p.procedure = proc (a : ℕ, b : ℕ) : ℕ { skip; return §a }
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem Experiment.NamedProcs.p.procedure.apply_simp (holeArgs✝ : GaudisCrypt.HoleSigs.empty.Instantiation) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            procedure.instantiate holeArgs✝ = proc (a : ℕ, b : ℕ) : ℕ { skip; return §a }

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Instantiating the holes of NamedProcs.p.procedure with a tuple holeArgs of procedures: the body of proc p as written, with each hole call replaced by the matching holeArgs.lookup (HoleIndex.zero being the first hole the body declared). True by rfl.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Deliberately not @[simp], unlike the other apply_simp lemmas: its right-hand side is the whole body written out, so letting it fire on its own would turn any goal mentioning an instantiated procedure into that body. Inlining a procedure is a step to ask for by name (simp [NamedProcs.p.procedure.apply_simp]).

It uses no module parameter, so it is not a function — NamedProcs.p.apply_simp says exactly that.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            noncomputable def Experiment.PartlyNamed.mk :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Structure → PartlyNamed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Builds a module of type PartlyNamed from the record PartlyNamed.Structure of its fields, as a right-nested Module.pair'. @[reducible].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Inverse of PartlyNamed.structure (PartlyNamed.mk_destruct, PartlyNamed.destruct_mk); a single field of a module built this way is read back by the @[simp] lemmas PartlyNamed.f.mk_simp.
